title: SEC4: watch_once event ID tracking is confusing
description:
Lines 333-381 in watch.rs have convoluted logic for tracking last_event_id:
- The code assigns 'let _ = new_id' twice (lines 341, 379) without actually using the value
- The comment on lines 335-341 suggests storing in last_message_state but doesn't actually do it properly
- A future maintainer won't understand if event IDs are being persisted across reconnects or not

SUGGESTION: Either document the event ID tracking mechanism clearly with a comment above the entire block, or simplify the code to make the intent obvious. The relationship between last_event_id and last_message_state needs explicit explanation.
